```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

## read
```{r}
spectral_example <- read_excel("data_samples.xlsx")
```

## filter
```{r}
spectral_example <- spectral_example |>
  filter(!is.na(sample_id))
```

## save
```{r}
usethis::use_data(spectral_example, overwrite = TRUE)
```
